a.text: How dull.
Did you think this would anger me? Offend me?
Did you think I would kick your corpse in anger? Curse your insolence?
I'm not going to do any of that, Lettou. René Lettou.
Insignificant man... same as the land itself in my eyes, an annoyance.
Did you think this act could give meaning to your pathetic life?
Still so conceited, Lettou.
I won't give you another thought, not so much as a momentary glance.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: ...Theresis.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Vampire.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: If memory serves, I have some sort of role in your hypocritical 'Military Commission'.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But I haven't seen a war report from you in quite some time?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Nor have you attended any Commission meetings in quite some time.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: You've always held the requisite command authority.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: 'Command authority.'

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I don't need to command my offspring, they serve me naturally, they serve their court.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Then you need to manage them better.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The war's end approaches, and your underlings need to play a more significant role. Their wanton behavior vexes me.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The western front is wasting time.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: This is necessary for the ritual.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Without enough blood and tears, how are we supposed to gather enough material for the witchcraft?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You and Theresa told me about the ancient door you found, covered in scabs.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Is the source of all Sarkaz suffering, the origin of our fate, really behind that door?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The preparations for the ritual are complete.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: But one of the nodes, the town of Brentwood, is under attack by our enemies.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Are you dispatching me to resolve these trifling nuisances for you, Theresis?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Oh, that reminds me, oh revered 'Regent' of the Military Commission—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Since the Commission has noted this is such a crucial town, why did it not prepare any significant defense?

spans.text: Since the Commission has noted this is such a
town, why did it not prepare any significant defense?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: No shrouded casters, meat puppets, or any haphazardly bewitched, flesh-woven brutes?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: ...I indulged you and your sister on account of your dazzlingly powerful souls.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Weak Sarkaz call you Regent, and the Confessarii have gathered around you, bringing Theresa back to you.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: The Regent and the resurrected 'King of Sarkaz', what a fascinating pair of siblings.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But all of this owes to your actions, your power, not your... status.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Power.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I have blessed this battlefield in order to cast the grandest of curses.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I, in my benevolence as head of one of the oldest of the courts, have awakened the power hidden within the blood of the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: And so, Theresis, have you felt it? Does my boon delight you?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Oh, but how much power can be drawn from your mixed blood?

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The end is near, it's making you restless.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Conceal your weakness.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Or shall I say, do you need a reminder or two?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I will complete the final part of the ritual for you, proud Regent.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But it is not in service of the narrow ambitions of you and your sister, eyes always fixed on that nomadic city bearing the false name of Kazdel.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: It's just another resting place in that painful river.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: Theresa is ready.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The Shard will soon unleash a power that Victoria could never imagine.

steps.name: Theresis
steps.text: The skeleton is waiting in the hub outside the encampment, you can go from there to Brentwood.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Exciting, isn't it...? Theresis, you always wear such dull, lifeless faces.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I've seen it. A black light rising over the horizon, like a wall of obsidian, that will eventually found a real city.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Heh... You mock my impatience, but isn't silence the best way to conceal your deepest thoughts?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: If only I could go back in time to see it for myself.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: If you really can retrieve the power that could reshape this great land, that which the Sarkaz first reached out to touch... 'Originium'.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Then I will, on your behalf, spread the name of Kazdel to every scrap of land I set foot on.

a.text: The Sarkaz, my people, have abandoned their past for too long.
They hate, they curse, they swear revenge upon our enemies.
So disappointing.
My people have forgotten even the origin of their bloodline, forgotten the names of our ancestors.
They mate in numbness and sorrow, giving birth to generations of hideous, mixed-blood offspring.
They throw themselves into the shadows of the nomadic cities, hiding in the streets, begging invaders for food.
I have lost interest in Victorian blood, and the Sarkaz who are satisfied with it... they infuriate me even more.
From the moment Sarkaz first called themselves Sarkaz, from the moment this 'world' alienated them—
It's enough to drive one mad with rage.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: My Prince, the drifting of the Feranmut is about to end, and we will soon arrive at the waystation near Brentwood.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: The town has been occupied by Victorians, and they are clearing out your creations.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Creations?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Those mindless insects are nothing more than a few drops of residual blood carelessly spilled by children of the Crimson Court while painting runes on crystals.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Let the Victorians celebrate their 'victory'.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: My mistake. Forgive me, Your Highness.

a.text: I look to the Military Commission's Major, a Sarkaz.
Theresis has arranged so many children to wander outside the court in this system of his.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You are called Ulšulah.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: ...Yes, Your Highness.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Your blood is mixed with too much alcohol. I can forgive hedonism and indulgence.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: But your hesitation disappoints.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I can wash those away for you, 'Major'.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: ...I am grateful for your benevolence, My Prince, but I can... handle myself. I... will endeavor to do better.

a.text: She bows her head, the nerves have gripped her.
But at least these mixed-blood children understand how to resist, which compensates somewhat for their ignorance.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Ulšulah... Ulšulah...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Ulšulah the Time-Stealer. A popular household story.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Hah, 'Ulšulah' has taken the reins of this particular skeleton. Amusing.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Just a coincidence, Your Highness. When I took the name, I never thought I would really be any kind of hero—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Hero?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Ulšulah was a coward.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: He couldn't even look directly into the eyes of this Feranmut, daring only to hide in the turbulent currents it stirred up, waking some of the people immersed in illusion.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: So I sent him on such a mission, of course, 'to save many people.'

a.text: Hollow murmurs echo throughout the space.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: What is it? Have recognized me at last?

a.text: Dead silence.
Its intelligence has long been stripped away. Only an empty shell remains to react.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: My Prince, we are nearly there.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: We may encounter some illusions—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: No need to remind me.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I've dealt with this one far more than you ever have.

a.text: The ashen Kazdel, sent to its doom in Diαbolic flames.
They sweep through the tents of all the clans.
I can hear the roar of the flames, I can hear the lamentations of the flames.
Why are we still surrendering? Why are we still weak?
Are you satisfied with this?
Are you satisfied?!
Then I, on your behalf—
My ancient kin kneel and weep in the ruins.
The King of Sarkaz is dead.
The King killed the King.
I know he is just a ripple in the illusion.
I know this is our unchangeable history.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: (In ancient Sarkaz) You worked hard to build this ashen Kazdel, and the Sarkaz have a home again.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: (In ancient Sarkaz) But doesn't its diminutive size infuriate you?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: (In ancient Sarkaz) The outblood invaders deprived the Teekaz of their ancestral land. So, you started to compromise, shrinking and distorting that which stands for your home.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: (In ancient Sarkaz) To a plain, a circle of fields, until you can only call it your city, your village.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: (In ancient Sarkaz) This is the starting point of Sarkaz weakness.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: (In ancient Sarkaz) And now, I look back from the endpoint.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: The illusions are over.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: This skeleton has returned to its lair.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: My Prince... it is my duty to remind you that the forces in control of the Brentwood core Arts Circle are nearby.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: They may not be aware that the skeleton leaves a trace. Our return may have been exposed.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: Your power is undeniable, but among our enemies, there may be...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: No matter.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Have our enemies destroyed the ritual nodes?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: The battlefield Arts Circles cast by this skeleton were merely the tendrils, extremities of the Crimson Court's grasp.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: In any case, since we've come to the end...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Allow me to personally stand as the center of this most ancient ritual—

a.text: The sun is rising, and the first rays of blood red have already spilled through the damaged cave of the waystation.
A new day.
But this day will be different from all the sorrowful days that have come before.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: 'Farchaser', eh? The crowned hunter, our first King of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: If your soul still lingers among the myriad after thousands of years—

a.text: Enough dark clouds have accumulated atop the spire known as The Shard.
The foolish Victorians see this storm as nothing more than a spear to be thrown.
How shallow, their inherently corrupt nature, always inclined toward conflict.
I close my eyes, feeling the Arts Circles composed of blood-red crystals, feeling all the blood that has flowed through this land since the war—No, since we degraded ourselves into Sarkaz.
They tremble at my mercy, they boil at my call.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: If you watch us yet, the descendants of your lost homeland...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: If those distant legends that have been distorted and painted over are not lies—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Then...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Let the suffering in that cradle descend again.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Let us... reclaim the lost fate of the Teekaz.

a.text: A drop of blood drips from my eye.
It flows down my face.
Such a distant voice answers me.
It's as if I could reach out and touch it.
That door, long buried in dust and smoke, is slowly loosening.
The storm over Londinium is playing a new movement.
Hm, it seems, something is missing...
A loud noise.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: ...As we thought, the Victorians are attacking here.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: We will do what we can to buy you time to complete the ritual, My Prince.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: The Victorians? Heh.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Theresis, you really have surprised me.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: No, no, girl called Ulšulah, we are not facing any such 'Victorians'.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Our guests deserve to witness this moment.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Another pureblood, still a young knell.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: And the usurper 'King of Sarkaz'.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: No matter who they are, the Military Commission's plan must be executed.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: I'll strengthen my connection with the Feranmut as much as possible, in order to prevent them from reaching this place.

steps.name: Ulšulah
steps.text: My Prince, please—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You have no standing from which to advise me.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Ah, I do so want to see—What cliches will they spout at me this time? What moments of despair can they show me?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Now then, 'Major', you stay here.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: This dispensable work of yours is over.

a.text: How many years have these hollow skeletons gone unfilled? Four centuries? Five?
At the time, I was not yet master of the Crimson Court.
At the time, I could still hear the arrogant whispers of the putrid War King, I could hear the sounds of the Arch-liar of Djall, torturing the night away.
At the time, even if the Vampires were hostile to them, these mighty souls surging with hatred and faith made my heart swell.
At the time, the Sarkaz were already a scattered people with no home to call their own. But at the time, I could see the remnants of their proud souls.

steps.text: 'Ruin'.

a.text: A sea of blood devours the curse.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Are you still toying with these pathetic words, these false curses, Banshee?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Why don't you face the power that truly belongs to you, the power gathered in your blood?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Isn't the elegy you can sing now so much more melodious?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Alas, you are silent, never to open your mouth.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Vampire.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: What is it you are trying to reach?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: This is no ritual recorded in Sarkaz literature.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What is it... calling?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's... I think I see a... 'seed'.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You... you're trying to awaken it with millennia-old witchcraft, to nourish it with the Arts Circles on the battlefields, and control it with the storm over The Shard.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You must be stopped!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You'll destroy Londinium! It'll be nothing but a heap of rubble full of Originium!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, not only that... at this scale, with this much power... I can even see...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The revenge of the Sarkaz will drag all of Terra into the abyss.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: ...'Revenge'.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Cautus, you still claim to be the King of Sarkaz, but your views are so biased.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Two hundred years ago, a coalition of Terran nations destroyed Kazdel once.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: And now, do you think we would bring pain and destruction to Victoria as simple vengeance for their conquest two centuries ago?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Sigh... I am disappointed once again.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: The Black Crown lingers over your head, and indeed, this is yet another ridiculous thing wrought by the 'King of Sarkaz'.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Killing an enemy and butchering a country, burying a city and annihilating a culture, these things are not different, for the Sarkaz, these are far from enough to be called resistance.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: We've come to Londinium, this outblood capital, not for any kind of 'retaliation'.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: 'Seed'? Not a bad description.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Watch and see what sights this seed will bring.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: You're a narrow-minded one, Vampire.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: No flowery words can change the nature of what it is you're doing.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: You call me silent?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Rest assured, Vampire, you will hear me speak.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: 'Fetters, fall heavy on your body.'

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Amiya!

a.text: The Black Crown appears over the outblood's head.
A black spear pierces my scapula.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What? So easy—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: —No! It's not!

a.text: Ah... fresh blood gushes out. The King of Sarkaz has opened a wound for me.
This is the blood so preciously bestowed to me and my ancestors for millennia.
I carefully select the blood of my choice.
The masters of the Crimson Court have a responsibility to, day after day, wipe away even the most minute hint of impurity.
But the reason we are so pure is not that this bloodline has never been lost, never been defiled.
But because—
I've finally found it.
A drop of blood.
It has been passed down through the millennia—
Teekaz blood.
The land falls silent, the rivers stagnate, the air moans.
The entire world turns solemn.
As I reach out my hand, it floats slowly in front of me. It does not drip.
It only goes up, up...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: His blood!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: He's going to complete the ritual!

a.text: Teekaz blood is now gone from our world.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: ...! The incantation left in Londinium was just destroyed in that instant.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: What's happened in Londinium?

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Amiya, end this battle quickly, I feel some kind of—

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Don't be so hasty, honored guests.

a.text: Blood crawls over the bones—
Bloodstains emerge from the decay.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: It's just such a great opportunity.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: In the sight of the first curse—perhaps today, we...

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Can bid farewell to the last 'King of Sarkaz'.
